original_title: Cannes Palme d’Or Goes to Renate Reinsve, Sebastian Stan Starrer ‘Fjord’
summary_en: Andreï Zvyagintsev's 'Minotaur' won the runner-up Grand Prix, with directing honors shared between the helmers of 'La Bola Negra' and 'Fatherland.'
